body: The initial color is irrelevant I think.
You can possibly avoid resizing if you use TextureRect's stretch modes.
I do not think there's a way to force `TextureRect` to use nearest neighbor scaling, and zoomed view should have crisp pixels.
You can set texture filter (it's CanvasItem property).
I just noticed that you are extracting an image only to make a texture. You could use AtlastTexture instead and set region.
